verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly offer agent-facing API credentials, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no way to issue scoped or least-privilege API keys. The only programmatic access is a keyless read endpoint on the Socrata open-data platform, which belongs to the host platform and involves no credentials, and prepaid accounts are an unrelated feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
